jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Quote Management, PCBA
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Quote Coordinator is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive customer quotations for printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) manufacturing services. This position serves as the central coordinator between Sales, Program Management, Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Test Engineering, Quality, suppliers, and customers to ensure that all technical and commercial requirements are understood and included in each quotation.

The ideal candidate has experience in electronics manufacturing and understands the complete PCBA process, including BOM review, PCB fabrication, SMT assembly, through-hole assembly, testing, tooling, materials, labor, and non-recurring engineering costs.

This role requires strong attention to detail, technical understanding, organization, communication, and the ability to manage multiple quotation deadlines while supporting profitable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare complete customer quotations for new products, repeat builds, and engineering changes.
Review customer RFQs and identify all technical, material, manufacturing, testing, quality, and documentation requirements.
Review Bills of Material, assembly drawings, fabrication drawings, Gerber files, pick-and-place files, assembly instructions, customer specifications, AVL/AML requirements, quality clauses, and revision histories.
Coordinate quoting activities with Sales, Program Management, Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, Test Engineering, Quality, PCB fabricators, component suppliers, and outside service providers.
Obtain and analyze supplier quotations for components, PCB fabrication, outside processing, tooling, fixtures, and other required services.
Identify long lead-time components, minimum order quantities, excess material exposure, lifecycle concerns, supply chain risks, and material availability issues.
Estimate costs related to materials, PCB fabrication, SMT assembly, through-hole assembly, manual assembly, mechanical assembly, box build, cable assemblies, testing, programming, fixtures, tooling, engineering support, NPI, NRE, conformal coating, selective solder, X-ray inspection, BGA inspection, rework, packaging, serialization, burn-in, environmental testing, source inspection, First Article Inspection, freight, expedite fees, and customer-specific documentation.
Evaluate manufacturing complexity, including board size, layer count, BGAs, CSPs, QFNs, press-fit connectors, mixed technology assemblies, IPC requirements, panelization, prototype versus production builds, yield assumptions, and test strategies.
Document quote assumptions, risks, supplier pricing, customer clarifications, engineering notes, revision history, and cost models.
Ensure quotations are accurate, complete, competitive, and submitted on time.
Support quote review meetings and assist with resolving technical or commercial questions before quote submission.
Maintain accurate records to support quote accuracy, margin review, and future quote revisions.

Qualifications

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Business, Electronics Technology, or equivalent experience.
3 to 7 years of experience in electronics manufacturing, PCBA, EMS, quoting, purchasing, program coordination, manufacturing engineering support, or related experience preferred.
Working knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, SMT assembly, through-hole assembly, PCB fabrication, BOM structures, AVL/AML requirements, electronic components, IPC standards, testing methods, manufacturing flow, supply chain fundamentals, and ERP/MRP systems.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, manufacturing documentation, customer specifications, and technical packages.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and follow-up skills.
Strong Excel skills and ability to work with detailed cost models, BOMs, and pricing information.
Ability to manage multiple quotations, deadlines, and priorities while maintaining accuracy.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing information, risk areas, and cost drivers.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Experience

Contract electronics manufacturing or PCBA quoting experience.
Experience with high-mix, low-volume manufacturing.
Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical electronics, robotics, advanced industrial, or other highly regulated customers.
Experience with prototype builds, NPI, production builds, box build, cable assemblies, or electromechanical assemblies.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IPC standards, customer quality clauses, and traceability requirements.
Experience working with PCB fabricators, electronic component suppliers, test providers, and outside processing vendors.

Success Profile

The successful Quote Coordinator combines technical understanding, commercial judgment, and strong quantitative acumen. They are comfortable working with detailed cost data, recognizing patterns in numbers, identifying inconsistencies, and asking questions when something does not look right. They understand manufacturing cost drivers and can connect customer requirements, material costs, labor, testing, tooling, lead times, and risk factors into a complete and accurate quotation.

This person is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive. They follow through on open items, keep quote activity moving, communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, and identify potential issues before they affect quote accuracy, timing, or profitability. The ideal candidate serves as an important bridge between customer requirements and manufacturing capabilities while helping Absolute EMS support profitable growth and strong customer relationships.

Benefits

Absolute EMS offers a competitive benefits package, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k)
Paid time off and company holidays
Life insurance and long-term disability
Employee Assistance Program
Optional voluntary benefits, including pet insurance, AD&D, supplemental life, and additional disability coverage

Our Culture

At Absolute EMS, we value quality, accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and customer service. We are a small but growing company where employees have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, work closely with leadership, and contribute directly to the success of our customers and the business.

Absolute EMS is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Downtown Seattle Office two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in the Greater Seattle Area or willing to relocate

Additionally, applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis, without the need for current or future employer sponsorship for an employment-based visa status.

Who we're looking for:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst
to partner closely with Rover’s Infosec team and Trust and Safety Leadership team, driving initiatives that make Rover a safer community for pet parents and sitters. This is a high-visibility role where you will collaborate directly with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, and improve
the success of Rover’s Fraud program. You will be responsible for conducting in-depth analysis of new and developing fraud trends, which includes proactively identifying issues and then developing and proposing actionable solutions. This role requires a unique skillset: the ideal candidate must be comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into crisp requirements, and then using those to build creative data products that meet niche business needs. You should be a natural builder - someone who is passionate about starting from ground zero and building a highly effective analytical program with relative autonomy.

Your Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Fraud leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health, operational performance, and magnitude of Fraud’s impact on our business. This includes establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key Fraud metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Develop and refine detection models: Develop and improve tooling and models to more effectively identify emerging fraud attacks, empowering the Fraud team to take quicker, more effective action to mitigate fraud across Rover's platform.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on investments and optimization strategies within Trust and Safety and Fraud.

Your Qualifications:

At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.

Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists

Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
Prior experience performing advanced fraud analytics within the technology sector.
Experience with the development and optimization of machine learning models
Hands on experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc) daily to simplify analytical work
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches semi-monthly

Summary:
The National Builder Project Coordinator supports the development, execution, and growth of national builder programs across multiple regions. This role serves as the primary liaison between National Accounts, Branch Leadership, Marketing, and Operations to ensure successful program implementation, operational alignment, reporting accuracy, and long-term business growth. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of managing multiple cross-functional initiatives while driving process improvements and supporting strategic national account objectives.

Monday to Friday from 08:00 AM to 05:00 PM

Seniority Level:
Mid-Senior Level

Employment Type:
Full-time

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to complete the following essential duties and responsibilities:

National Builder Program Management

Coordinate the launch and implementation of national builder programs in newly awarded markets.
Introduce and onboard branch teams to national builder programs, ensuring alignment with program standards, expectations, and operational requirements.
Coordinate strategic sample distribution to support new program launches and market expansions.
Partner with Branch Leadership to assess market readiness and facilitate successful program implementation.
Support contract execution, pricing alignment, rebates, product continuums, and program renewal activities.
Monitor program compliance and ensure consistent execution across participating branches.

Builder Shows & Events

Plan, coordinate, and execute national and regional builder trade shows, meetings, and partner events.
Coordinate internal approvals, event logistics, booth setup and teardown, sample materials, tabletop displays, and meeting preparation.
Document meeting discussions and distribute follow-up action items to internal stakeholders.
Track and manage leads generated through builder events and collaborate with branch teams to ensure timely follow-up.
Maintain Builder Tracking Reports and provide post-event summaries highlighting opportunities, risks, and recommended next steps.

Process Improvement & Program Execution

Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, communication, and visibility across national builder programs.
Streamline coordination between National Accounts and branch teams.
Improve lead tracking, reporting, and sample distribution processes.
Support resolution of startup challenges and program execution issues.
Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and program records within SharePoint and other internal systems.

Reporting & Analytics

Maintain and update key business reports, including:

Builder Wins Report
National Builder Activity Report
Master Crossover List
National Program Rollout Tracker

Builder Growth Report
RFP, Program & Bid Tracker
Analyze program performance and provide leadership with actionable insights on growth opportunities, risks, and operational improvements.
Support forecasting, pipeline management, and program visibility across all regions.

Marketing & Sales Support

Develop and update marketing and sales collateral for trade shows, builder meetings, RFPs, and national program presentations, including product catalogs, architectural binders, brochures, presentations, sample displays, pricing documents, and proposal materials.
Partner with Marketing to ensure consistent branding and professional presentation standards.
Support strategic positioning for competitive bids, RFP responses, and national builder program rollouts.
Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, pivot tables, reporting, and large dataset management.

Strong organizational, analytical, and project coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Experience with SharePoint, CRM systems, reporting tools, or project management software is preferred.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify process improvements and drive operational efficiencies.
